rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to say that someone or something cannot be wrong.

example.english: His choice of restaurant is infallibly right.
example.traditional: 我信佢揀嗰間餐廳，一定唔會錯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seon3 keoi5 gaan2 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jat1 ding6 m4 wui5 co3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the person gets it right every single time.

example.english: He infallibly gets his football predictions right every time.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gu2 bo1 ci3 ci3 dou1 ngaam1

rows.note: Use this mainly for an action or plan that is guaranteed not to fail, rather than for a person's statements.

example.english: Following these steps makes the whole process infallibly successful.
example.traditional: 跟足呢個步驟，成件事就萬無一失。
example.jyutping: gan1 zuk1 ni1 go3 bou6 zaau6 sing4 gin6 si6 zau6 maan6 mou4 jat1 sat1
